scope: Diagnostic registration by an exact shared compressed-source token boundary. No candidate selection, image alignment, new source changes, or authenticity claim.
dictionary: Both streams share the same arbitrary 32768-byte incoming dictionary. Known means a literal descendant under each selected nominal parse; it does not mean authenticated original data. A tag is a known value or the negative identity of an initial dictionary byte.

interpretation.nominalUnequal: Different decoded bytes with the codec zero dictionary.
interpretation.knownUnequal: Different values at positions where both decodes are independent of the incoming dictionary; guaranteed unequal for any shared dictionary.
interpretation.symbolicTagDisagreements: Known unequal or unresolved dictionary expressions. Different unknown tags need not have different actual values.
interpretation.historyConvergence: First 32768-byte all-tag-equal window wholly after resynchronization. Together with the verified identical future instructions, it proves aligned LZ state equality thereafter.
interpretation.coordinates: All first/last difference coordinates are zero-based baseline payload bytes, not image pixels. Ranges are half-open. candidate position = baseline position + outputDelta.
interpretation.suffix: The permanent equal suffix is equality of literal values/initial-history expressions; literal-token IDs need not coincide. Counts after resynchronization omit the locally reparsed span and are not whole-payload edit distances.
interpretation.commonKnown: B2–4 tokens are paired by the identical full instruction suffix and checked by stream bit. Both endpoint values must be independent of the incoming dictionary in both decodes. First/final data tokens and lengths258 are excluded. Positive-cost match-plus-literal absorptions may change the LL symbol; counts use the same common-known token set and retained codebook. These are encoder/cost diagnostics, not universal DEFLATE invalidity or authenticity tests.
interpretation.synthetic: Blocks 12, 13, and 20 retain synthetic endings from the baseline recipe. Results describe these candidate streams, not an authenticated complete PNG.
